comment: The AI ladder's players (D318): a name, an AI kind and its parameters. A name is permanent: never edit the kind or params of a player that has played (the ladder keys results by name AND config hash, so an edit would split it in two); add a new name instead. Anchors are stock Forge and are always in the pool; forge-default is fixed at 1500. tools/ai-ladder/kinds.ts lists the kinds and their parameters. `ai-ladder.sh tune` appends here and never overwrites.

players.name: forge-default
players.note: Forge 2.0.14's AI, Default.ai profile. The rating scale's zero: 1500.

players.name: forge-reckless
players.note: Reckless.ai; D311 measured it about +10 points over Default on the cube pairs.

players.name: forge-experimental
players.note: Experimental.ai: 30 knob values, not simulation (D311).

players.name: policy-outlet
players.note: D310's sacrifice-outlet policy in front of the Default AI.

players.name: search-v1
players.note: The game's `MtgTable --ai-policy search` seat with its defaults until D412: D310's outlet policy plus D312's determinized rollout search (D312-D314). Wall-clock budget: for live play, and machine-dependent as a benchmark. Since D412 the live seat is search-v2, the player search-v1-anytime; `--ai-search anytime=0` is this one.

players.name: search-v1-fixed3
players.note: Fixed-rollout benchmark mode: exactly 3 rounds per searched decision (search-v1 averaged ~2.5 on the shared container at 1.5 s), a fixed determinization seed, no budget fallback. Use this one for ladder, SPRT and tuner numbers that must reproduce across machines.

players.name: search-v1-fixed3-aturns1
players.note: D351 (engine review H1(c)): search-v1-fixed3 with ATTACK rollouts played to the end of the NEXT turn (aturns=1), so an attack sees the crack-back; every other decision keeps turns=0. Night 2's SPRT against search-v1-fixed3.

players.name: search-v1-fixed3-lcb
players.note: D350 (engine review M1): search-v1-fixed3 overriding Forge only when the paired difference's lower bound mean_d - 1*se_d clears 0 (3 rounds), instead of the raw mean beating Forge's by 20. Night 2's SPRT against search-v1-fixed3.

players.name: search-v1-fixed3-oracle
players.note: D350 (engine review M5): TEST ONLY -- search-v1-fixed3 whose rollouts keep the REAL hidden cards (no determinization). An upper bound on what inferring the opponent's hand could be worth; never a live seat (MtgTable refuses oracle=1), never rated by `run` unless named, never a league candidate. Night 2's SPRT against search-v1-fixed3.

players.name: search-v1-anytime
players.note: D388 (engine review, week 3): search-v1 with the anytime search -- a round the 1.5 s budget cuts keeps its rollouts, candidates are pruned to what the time left can carry, clearly worse ones are raced out, and the verdict is taken on whatever paired evidence exists (Forge's answer without a verdict only when no alternative was scored). Wall-clock by design: it is the budget behaviour being measured. SPRT against search-v1. D412 (J102's fixed match, ADOPT: 0.5133 [0.5036, 0.5230] against search-v1, budget fallbacks 0.7% vs 5.6%): this config is search-v2, the live `MtgTable --ai-policy search` seat's default (SearchConfig.LIVE_VERSION); the name stays, as every ladder name does.

players.name: search-v1-fixed3-ranked
players.note: D389 (week 3): search-v1-fixed3 generating up to 24 candidates and keeping Forge's, pass and the best 4 others by a one-step prior (each applied once on a shared determinization, the leaf after it) instead of the first 6 in enumeration order. SPRT against search-v1-fixed3.

players.name: search-v1-fixed3-routlets
players.note: D390 (week 3): search-v1-fixed3 whose rollouts play the searching seat with D310's sacrifice-outlet policy in front of Forge instead of plain Forge, so sacrifice lines are valued as the seat would play them. SPRT against search-v1-fixed3.

players.name: search-v1-reckless
players.note: D398 (the outside review's T5): search-v1 with Forge's Reckless.ai as the base profile instead of Default -- the seat's own answers, and its side of every rollout (the copy keeps the seat's lobby player, so its profile), are Reckless; every search knob is search-v1's. Wall-clock like search-v1, so it is the live opponent being measured. Against forge-default and search-v1 (J101).

players.name: search-v2-mull
players.note: D417: search-v2 (the ladder's search-v1-anytime) plus the opening-hand search, mull=1: at mulliganKeepHand keep is rolled out against mulligan, and at the London bottom Forge's cards against others, from the pre-game copy to game turn 6 (mullturns 3 a seat), 6 s a decision (mullms), overruling Forge only on the lcb rule (z 1, 3 paired rounds). Every other knob search-v2's. Fixed match against search-v1-anytime.

players.name: search-v2-targets
players.note: D417: search-v2 plus the target search, targets=1: when the seat's priority play (Forge's or the search's) has a part with one target, Forge's target is rolled out against up to 5 other legal ones (Forge's side first, then Forge's card value), on search-v2's own rule and budget. Fixed match against search-v1-anytime.

players.name: search-v2-mull-targets
players.note: D417: search-v2 with both switches, mull=1 and targets=1. Registered for a later match; J114 measures each switch alone.

players.name: search-v2-evalleaf
players.note: J128 (D437): search-v2 (search-v1-anytime, every knob its own) whose unfinished rollouts are scored by the learned evaluator v2 (D364's nights-1-3 model, J067; var/ml/models/nights-1-3-eval.json, sha256 dcdae3745b84..., registered as var/ml/models/eval-dcdae3745b84.json) through D354's leaf=eval:<model>: LEAF_SCALE * logit(P(the searching seat wins)), read from that seat's own knowledge only (D316). The model file is PC-only (gitignored), so elsewhere this player is unavailable, never another model. Fixed match against search-v1-anytime (J128).

players.name: search-v2-ms3000-r24
players.note: D514: search-v2 at 3000 ms and 24 rounds a decision (its 1500 ms and 12 rounds x 2): the compute-curve arm of D514; for measurement, never the live seat. Every other param search-v1-anytime's (search-v2): the 2 minimum rounds, racing from round 3 at z 2, each rollout's 20,000-step cap and its step clock 2 s past the deadline (D468), Forge's 1 s think limit in the copy. The round cap scales with the budget because a budget alone was mostly unspent (D514's pilot: 4x the clock bought 1.41x the time and ~15% more rollouts). Fixed matches against search-v1-anytime on the compute-curve night (the play-AI review of 2026-11-05, section 5 row 2).

players.note: D514: search-v2 at 6000 ms and 48 rounds a decision (its 1500 ms and 12 rounds x 4): the compute-curve arm of D514; for measurement, never the live seat. Every other param search-v1-anytime's (search-v2): the 2 minimum rounds, racing from round 3 at z 2, each rollout's 20,000-step cap and its step clock 2 s past the deadline (D468), Forge's 1 s think limit in the copy. The round cap scales with the budget because a budget alone was mostly unspent (D514's pilot: 4x the clock bought 1.41x the time and ~15% more rollouts). Fixed matches against search-v1-anytime on the compute-curve night (the play-AI review of 2026-11-05, section 5 row 2).

players.note: D517: search-v2 whose rollouts play the searching seat with D310's sacrifice-outlet policy in front of Forge (D390's rollout=outlets, measured until now only under the fixed three-round search, search-v1-fixed3-routlets): the rollout-policy knob arm of D517; for measurement, never the live seat. Every other param search-v1-anytime's (search-v2): 1500 ms and 12 rounds a decision, the 2 minimum rounds, racing from round 3 at z 2, each rollout's 20,000-step cap and its step clock 2 s past the deadline (D468), Forge's 1 s think limit in the copy. Fixed match against search-v1-anytime on J195 (D517's pre-registered rule).

players.note: D517: search-v2 generating up to 24 candidates and keeping Forge's, pass and the best others by D389's one-step prior (rank=prior, gen=24: each applied once on a shared determinization, the leaf after it, within 30% of the budget), measured until now only under the fixed three-round search (search-v1-fixed3-ranked): the candidate-ranking knob arm of D517; for measurement, never the live seat. Every other param search-v1-anytime's (search-v2): 1500 ms and 12 rounds a decision, the 2 minimum rounds, racing from round 3 at z 2, each rollout's 20,000-step cap and its step clock 2 s past the deadline (D468), Forge's 1 s think limit in the copy. Fixed match against search-v1-anytime on J195 (D517's pre-registered rule).

players.note: D517: search-v2 at 750 ms and 6 rounds a decision (its 1500 ms and 12 rounds x 0.5, scaled together as D514's arms are): the compute curve's lower half, D517; for measurement, never the live seat. Every other param search-v1-anytime's (search-v2): the 2 minimum rounds, racing from round 3 at z 2, each rollout's 20,000-step cap and its step clock 2 s past the deadline (D468), Forge's 1 s think limit in the copy. players.note: D517: search-v2 at 375 ms and 3 rounds a decision (its 1500 ms and 12 rounds x 0.25, scaled together as D514's arms are): the compute curve's lower half, D517; for measurement, never the live seat. players.name: search-v2-rrandom
players.note: D523: search-v2 whose rollouts play BOTH seats with the search's random seat, random-v2 (rollout=random: the move atlas's random seat with its guardrails G1-G6 and D485-D488, asking Forge's AI for no answer, plus D523's rollout guardrails R1-R7, each counted as search.rr.v2.*), instead of Forge's Default AI: Forge out of the rollout loop. Every other param search-v1-anytime's (search-v2): 1500 ms and 12 rounds a decision, the 2 minimum rounds, racing from round 3 at z 2, each rollout's 20,000-step cap and its step clock 2 s past the deadline (D468), Forge's 1 s think limit in the copy; the candidate is still forced as the searching seat's first answer and the leaf is the hand leaf. For measurement, never the live seat. Fixed match against search-v1-anytime on J199 (D523's pre-registered rule).

players.name: search-v2-rrandom-self
players.note: D523: search-v2 whose rollouts play the searching seat with the search's random seat, random-v2 (rollout=random-self, as search-v2-rrandom), and the opponent with Forge's Default AI as before. Every other param search-v1-anytime's (search-v2): 1500 ms and 12 rounds a decision, the 2 minimum rounds, racing from round 3 at z 2, each rollout's 20,000-step cap and its step clock 2 s past the deadline (D468), Forge's 1 s think limit in the copy; the candidate is still forced as the searching seat's first answer and the leaf is the hand leaf. players.name: search-v2-rrandom3
players.note: D525: search-v2 whose rollouts play BOTH seats with random-v3's block seat (rollout=random3: D523's random-v2 -- the atlas's random seat, asking Forge's AI for no answer, with R1-R7 -- plus R8 alone, a blocker that can block an attacker, destroy it and survive takes that block, counted as search.rr.v3.goodBlock): search-v2-rrandom with one rule added, measured against J199's search-v2-rrandom. Every other param search-v1-anytime's (search-v2), as search-v2-rrandom. For measurement, never the live seat. Fixed match against search-v1-anytime under D525's pre-registered rule.

players.name: search-v2-rrandom3-held
players.note: D525: search-v2 whose rollouts play BOTH seats with random-v3's held seat (rollout=random3-held: search-v2-rrandom3's seat, D523's random-v2 plus R8, with R9 added, a harmful instant or ability on the opponent's turn waits for an empty stack and combat after blockers or the end step, counted as search.rr.v3.heldInstant): search-v2-rrandom3 with one rule added, measured against it on the same night and deals, so the difference is R9. Every other param search-v1-anytime's (search-v2), as search-v2-rrandom. For measurement, never the live seat. Fixed match against search-v1-anytime under D525's pre-registered rule.

players.name: search-v2-rrandom4
players.note: D527: search-v2 whose rollouts play BOTH seats with random-v4 (rollout=random4: search-v2-rrandom3's seat, D523's random-v2 plus R8, with R8 made lethal-aware -- under a lethal attack a good block is made only if the seat survives it, and after a dead draw R2's redraws keep the surviving assignment with the most good blocks, counted as search.rr.v4.goodBlockLethal; no R9): search-v2-rrandom3 with one change, read against J201's search-v2-rrandom3. Every other param search-v1-anytime's (search-v2), as search-v2-rrandom. For measurement, never the live seat. Fixed match against search-v1-anytime under D527's pre-registered rule.

players.name: search-v2-rrandom4-m40
players.note: D527: search-v2-rrandom4 with the override margin raised from 20 to 40 leaf points (an alternative must beat Forge's own answer by 40 to override it; about 2 points of win rate at 50%, D349's scale): the random rollouts' values are noisier and J201's arms overrode Forge about twice as often as search-v2 at priority under the same margin of 20. search-v2-rrandom4 with one change, measured against it on the same night and deals, so the difference is the margin. Every other param search-v1-anytime's (search-v2). For measurement, never the live seat. Fixed match against search-v1-anytime under D527's pre-registered rule.

players.name: search-v2-rrandom4-m60
players.note: D528: search-v2-rrandom4 with the override margin raised from 20 to 60 leaf points (search-v2-rrandom4-m40's random-v4 rollouts unchanged, its margin 40 raised to 60): J202 read the margin as the one lever that moved (rrandom4 -39.5 Elo, rrandom4-m40 -20.9, its overrides of Forge down from 33.3% to 26.4% of searched decisions), and as the margin rises the arm converges on the seat under the search, policy-outlet, which J204 plays on the same deals as the baseline. Every other param search-v1-anytime's (search-v2). For measurement, never the live seat. Fixed match against search-v1-anytime under D528's pre-registered rule.

players.name: search-v2-rrandom4-lcb-m60
players.note: D530: search-v2-rrandom4-m60 with D350's noise-aware override rule (override=lcb, z 1, D350's registered value): Forge's answer is overruled only when the lower bound mean_d - z*se_d of the best alternative's paired per-round difference to it clears the margin of 60 leaf points, over at least 3 paired rounds, where search-v2-rrandom4-m60 overrules on the mean alone. random-v4's rollouts unchanged. J205's deciding arm when J204's v6Margin is 60 (D528 point 8), else its exploratory arm. Every other param search-v1-anytime's (search-v2). For measurement, never the live seat. Fixed match against search-v1-anytime under D530's pre-registered rule.

players.name: search-v2-rrandom4-lcb-m40
players.note: D530: search-v2-rrandom4-m40 with D350's noise-aware override rule (override=lcb, z 1, D350's registered value): Forge's answer is overruled only when the lower bound mean_d - z*se_d of the best alternative's paired per-round difference to it clears the margin of 40 leaf points, over at least 3 paired rounds, where search-v2-rrandom4-m40 overrules on the mean alone. random-v4's rollouts unchanged. J205's deciding arm when J204's v6Margin is 40 (D528 point 8), else its exploratory arm. Every other param search-v1-anytime's (search-v2). For measurement, never the live seat. Fixed match against search-v1-anytime under D530's pre-registered rule.

players.name: search-v2-rrandom4them-lcb-m40
players.note: D531 (random-v7, pre-registered by D530 point 7): search-v2-rrandom4-lcb-m40 with one change, rollout=random4-them -- in the rollouts only the OPPONENT's seat plays random-v4 (random4's seat, R8 made lethal-aware), and the searching seat plays its own continuation as search-v2's rollouts do (Forge's Default AI, its candidate forced first): random-self's seating reversed. The verdict is J205's deciding arm's unchanged (D350's override=lcb, z 1, at J204's v6Margin of 40). A candidate here would mean the random opponent model is as good as Forge's for the search, with Forge still in the loop for the searching seat. Every other param search-v1-anytime's (search-v2). For measurement, never the live seat. Fixed match against search-v1-anytime under D531's pre-registered rule.

players.name: search-v2-rrandom4them-m40
players.note: D532 (random-v8): search-v2-rrandom4them-lcb-m40 with one change, the override rule back to the margin rule (no override=lcb): rollout=random4-them -- in the rollouts only the OPPONENT's seat plays random-v4 (random4's seat, R8 made lethal-aware), and the searching seat plays its own continuation as search-v2's rollouts do (Forge's Default AI, its candidate forced first) -- with Forge's answer overruled when the best alternative's mean paired difference to it clears 40 leaf points. J206's counters, read with lcb on, had the from-pass share lcb was brought in for (D530) under search-v2's (5.1% against 8.0%) and lcb still holding 35.5% of the overrides; this arm measures the them-only seating without lcb. Every other param search-v1-anytime's (search-v2). For measurement, never the live seat. Fixed match against search-v1-anytime under D532's pre-registered rule.

players.name: search-v2-rrandom4them
players.note: D532 (random-v8): rollout=random4-them at search-v2's own override rule and margin (the margin rule at 20, no margin key, as search-v2-rrandom4): in the rollouts only the OPPONENT's seat plays random-v4 and the searching seat plays its own continuation as search-v2's rollouts do. search-v2-rrandom4them-m40 with the margin at search-v2's 20: D527 raised it to 40 only for the priority overrides' excess, which J206 no longer showed with lcb on; whether it is gone under the margin rule is what the two D532 arms measure. Every other param search-v1-anytime's (search-v2). For measurement, never the live seat. Fixed match against search-v1-anytime under D532's pre-registered rule.

players.name: search-v2-rmix4them-m40
players.note: D533 (random-v9, pre-registered by D532 point 5, the random-rollout track's last iteration): search-v2-rrandom4them-m40 with one change, rollout=mix4-them -- a decision's rollouts alternate by round between search-v2's own Forge rollout (both seats Forge's Default AI) and random4-them's (the OPPONENT's seat random-v4, the searching seat Forge's Default AI with its candidate forced first), round 0 Forge's; every candidate in a round shares its determinization and its kind, so each paired difference is taken inside one kind, and the margin rule overrules Forge when the best alternative's mean paired difference over all rounds clears 40 leaf points. Every other param search-v1-anytime's (search-v2). For measurement, never the live seat. Fixed match against search-v1-anytime under D533's pre-registered rule, if J208 (the random-v8 night D532 calls J207) names margin 40.

players.name: search-v2-rmix4them
players.note: D533 (random-v9, pre-registered by D532 point 5, the random-rollout track's last iteration): search-v2-rrandom4them with one change, rollout=mix4-them -- a decision's rollouts alternate by round between search-v2's own Forge rollout (both seats Forge's Default AI) and random4-them's (the OPPONENT's seat random-v4), round 0 Forge's -- at search-v2's own override rule and margin (the margin rule at 20, no margin key); search-v2-rmix4them-m40 with the margin at 20. Every other param search-v1-anytime's (search-v2). For measurement, never the live seat. Fixed match against search-v1-anytime under D533's pre-registered rule, if J208 (the random-v8 night D532 calls J207) names margin 20.

A decision of a kind the search does not look at is never searched and costs no search time; the kinds it does look at are searched exactly as search-v2 searches them (1500 ms and 12 rounds a decision, Forge's rollouts). Every other param search-v1-anytime's. For measurement, never the live seat. Fixed match against forge-default on the deals of D535's night, beside search-v1-anytime's own match on them.

players.name: search-v2-t1
players.note: D537 (the search's horizon): search-v2 (search-v1-anytime) with turns=1 and aturns=0 -- priority and block rollouts play to the end of the NEXT turn, so a main-phase play is scored after the opponent's reply turn and a block (declared in the opponent's turn) after the AI's own next turn, while attack rollouts keep search-v2's horizon (aturns=0 written out: unset, aturns would follow turns and attacks would deepen too). The same 1.5 s clock and 12-round cap, so each decision gets fewer, longer rollouts (D312's pilot: one more turn costs about three times a rollout). Every other param search-v1-anytime's. For measurement, never the live seat. Fixed 1,200-game match against search-v1-anytime under D537's pre-registered readings (J212).

players.name: search-v2-a1
players.note: D537 (the search's horizon): search-v2 (search-v1-anytime) with aturns=1 -- attack rollouts play to the end of the NEXT turn, so an attack is scored after the opponent's crack-back turn; priority and block rollouts keep turns=0. The same 1.5 s clock and 12-round cap. D351 measured aturns=1 on the older fixed-3-round search (search-v1-fixed3-aturns1, stopped at 50.2% over 488 games, D367); this is its first match on the anytime search. Every other param search-v1-anytime's. For measurement, never the live seat. Fixed 1,200-game match against search-v1-anytime under D537's pre-registered readings (J212).

players.name: search-v2-t1-x3
players.note: D537 (the search's horizon): search-v2-t1 at three times the clock -- turns=1 and aturns=0 (priority and block rollouts to the end of the next turn, attacks at search-v2's horizon) with a 4.5 s budget a searched decision and the round cap left at 12, so a deeper decision gets about the rollouts search-v2 gets now (D312's pilot: one more turn costs about three times a rollout). The clock is every kind's (SearchConfig has one budget), so attacks get 4.5 s at search-v2's horizon too. Every other param search-v1-anytime's. For measurement, never the live seat. Fixed 1,200-game match against search-v1-anytime under D537's pre-registered readings (J212).
